name: Bitbucket
description: Repositories, pull requests, and Atlassian engineering workflows.
notes: Bitbucket Cloud is reached through Atlassian's hosted Rovo MCP server (Atlassian MCP v2), the same connection as Jira and Confluence: sign in with your Atlassian account when the authentication flow starts. The REST option is for OAuth apps against the Bitbucket API.
installHint: This connects Atlassian Rovo's hosted MCP server, whose Bitbucket tools work only with Bitbucket Cloud workspaces linked to an Atlassian organization and cannot reach Bitbucket Data Center. On OpenHands Cloud and Enterprise, signing in with Bitbucket Cloud or connecting it under Settings -> Integrations is an alternative.
